description.value: Local Pizza is a Vancouver Island–born pizza chain with five Victoria-area outlets, including food court locations at Hillside and Mayfair malls and standalone shops on Douglas, Shelbourne, and Goldstream. The chain emphasises fresh ingredients and locally hired staff, positioning itself as a neighbourhood alternative to national pizza brands. Cyclists passing through Victoria will find multiple convenient locations for a quick pizza or side order via walk-in pickup or online ordering.
